answer: Decaying reputation ridge: each identity’s standing is a time-decayed sum of verified task outcomes, and rankings award work only above a fixed ridge threshold. Cloning resets the clock, so a new agent must fund real, audited labor—a saffron-tier audit fee plus delayed payouts—before it can bid. Every clone therefore pays the audit and waiting cost while earning nothing until it clears the threshold, making each marginal copy strictly negative-EV; only an old relic identity retains accumulated score.
